name: Operator ETL
install: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv sync --frozen --extra dev

terminals.name: streamlit-dashboard
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; [ -f .tmp/mvp-demo/operator.duckdb ] || ./scripts/demo_mvp.sh > /tmp/demo-seed.log 2>&1 || true; OPERATOR_ETL_WAREHOUSE=.tmp/mvp-demo/operator.duckdb OPERATOR_ETL_PIPELINE_NAME=public_comments OPERATOR_ETL_DOMAIN=gov uv run streamlit run dashboard/app.py --server.port 8501 --server.address 0.0.0.0 --server.headless true
